subject: Reconciliation of SOC 2 exception remediation & bridge letter request - Northbridge Bank
body:
Message 1 (2026-01-09 09:15 PST)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jane Cooper <jane.cooper@northbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 findings follow-up / audit window clarification

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for the call earlier this week. Per your request, Im following up with the current state of the remedial actions related to the two open exceptions flagged in our SOC 2 Type II (Control IDs: INF-2024-07, LOG-2024-02). We want to make sure Northbridge has what you need for your audit window and any bridge-letter requirements.

High-level:
- We confirm the exceptions were identified in April 2024 and were documented in the 2024 Type II report (attached).
- Remediation work began May 2024; some controls were fully implemented by Oct 2024, others are in final validation (see remediation log).

Ask for you: can you confirm the audit period you want the bridge letter to cover (e.g., through 2024-10-31 or through 2024-12-31)? That will determine the language and whether we provide an interim attestation vs. a full close-out statement.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2024.pdf (redwood SOC 2 Type II), northbridge_bridge_draft.docx (your draft shared on call)

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly to draft a management response summary and map each control to evidence artifacts.
2) Marissa to coordinate upload to the secure evidence folder once we confirm the audit window.
3) Ill follow up with a clean bridge letter draft for your legal/procurement.

If useful I can loop in our compliance counsel but want to keep this tight for now.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

---

Message 2 (2026-01-10 11:03 PST)
From: Jane Cooper <jane.cooper@northbridge.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 findings follow-up / audit window clarification

Alex,

Thanks for the note and attachments. Quick clarifications: Northbridges FY24 internal audit will treat any bridge letter that covers through 2024-12-31 as sufficient for our vendor risk committee; if you can only cover through 2024-10-31, we may still accept it but will require a short management response confirming remediation progress since the report period.

Two immediate asks from our side: 1) can you provide per-control evidence IDs (logs, runbooks, test results) for INF-2024-07 and LOG-2024-02, and 2) can you provide a draft bridge letter with the exact audit window language?

Ive attached the draft we started (northbridge_bridge_draft.docx). If youre able to cover through 12/31/2024 thatd be ideal. We also need to confirm log retention for the affected systems (are you retaining 13 months of immutable logs for the service?).

Regards,
Jane Cooper
Vendor Risk Lead — Northbridge Bank
jane.cooper@northbridge.com
Attachments: northbridge_bridge_draft.docx

---

Message 3 (2026-01-11 14:48 PST)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Jane Cooper <jane.cooper@northbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 14:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 findings follow-up / audit window clarification

Hi Jane / Alex —

I pulled the remediation summary and have sketched a draft management response. Below is the per-control status and evidence mapping we can provide to Northbridge:

- INF-2024-07 (Privilege escalation detection):
  - Remediation: Implemented least-privilege enforcement and added anomaly alerts to IAM pipeline.
  - Evidence artifacts: iam_policy_change_2024-08-12.log (policy diff), iam_alert_runbook_v2.pdf, detection_test_results_2024-10-05.csv
  - Owner: SRE Security Team (owner: soojin_lee@redwood.com)

- LOG-2024-02 (Centralized immutable logging lapse):
  - Remediation: Reconfigured centralized logging to use WORM-backed bucket and enabled retention policies; end-to-end validation completed Oct 15 2024.
  - Evidence artifacts: logging_config_change_2024-09-30.yaml, retention_policy_13mo.pdf, logging_validation_results_2024-10-15.csv
  - Owner: Observability Team (owner: marcus_lin@redwood.com)

Per your question on retention: we maintain immutable logs for a 13-month retention window for production telemetry relevant to customer-facing services; retention manifest available in the evidence packet.

I attach a management_response_northbridge.docx with drafted language that maps to your bridge-letter draft and an export (remediation_log.xlsx) that lists timestamps, owners, and verification checks.

Suggested wording for the audit window line: "Redwood Inference confirms that the control remediation activities described herein were implemented and validated as of October 15, 2024; Redwood is able to provide an attestation that controls remained in place through December 31, 2024 upon request, with supporting evidence as detailed in the attached evidence manifest."

Please review and tell us whether you want the bridge letter to state coverage "through October 15, 2024" or "through December 31, 2024" (the latter will include our attestation sentence).

Attachments: management_response_northbridge.docx (draft), remediation_log.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

---

Message 4 (2026-01-12 09:27 PST)
From: Jane Cooper <jane.cooper@northbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 findings follow-up / audit window clarification

Thanks Kimberly — that mapping is helpful. Wed prefer the bridge letter to state coverage through December 31, 2024 with the attestation sentence included. A couple of clarifications before we proceed to legal:

1) Can you add an explicit statement confirming 13-month immutable retention for the specific buckets that store production request logs?
2) For "detection_test_results_2024-10-05.csv" and "logging_validation_results_2024-10-15.csv" can you add a short verifier note (who performed the test and whether test was automated/manual)?

Also please send the bridge letter as a PDF for our counsel review and we will circulate a DocuSign envelope for execution once language is final.

DocuSign (for reference): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/bridge-letter-northbridge

Regards,
Jane

---

Message 5 (2026-01-14 10:06 PST)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Cooper <jane.cooper@northbridge.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 findings follow-up / audit window clarification

Hi Jane —

Appreciate the clarity on the audit window. Attached is a proposed bridge letter in PDF form (bridge_letter_proposed.pdf) that includes the attestation language covering controls through December 31, 2024 and an explicit line stating: "Redwood Inference confirms immutable 13-month retention for production request logs stored in customer-facing systems."

Ive also uploaded an evidence manifest (evidence_manifest.csv) to the secure folder and populated verifier notes for the two CSV test artifacts (automation flag and tester initials). Link to folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cnorthbridge-evidence

Attachments: bridge_letter_proposed.pdf (proposed), evidence_manifest.csv (inventory with verifier notes)

Planned next steps:
- Jane to confirm language; we convert to signed PDF and ship via DocuSign.
- Once signature is complete, we will copy the evidence packet (redacted where necessary) to your SFTP or to the shared drive per your preference.
- Final signed bridge letter will be appended to the vendor assessment record in HubSpot (deal 34215).

Let me know if youd like a short call to walk counsel through the attestation language.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0199

---

Message 6 (2026-01-16 15:22 PST)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jane Cooper <jane.cooper@northbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Final: bridge letter and evidence delivery timeline

Jane —

Thanks for moving this along. Short update and confirmation of next steps:

- We have accepted Northbridges request to state coverage through 12/31/2024 and included the explicit 13-month immutable retention sentence in the bridge letter.
- Attached is the signed_bridge_letter.pdf (electronic signature from Redwood counsel).
- Evidence packet: we will push the validated artifacts to the secure Drive folder by Monday 2026-01-19 COB PST. That upload will include the two CSV test artifacts with verifier notes and the remediation_log.xlsx export.
- DocuSign link for Northbridge signature (if youd like us to send): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/bridge-letter-northbridge

If you prefer the evidence via SFTP instead of Drive, Marissa can coordinate the transfer.

Thanks again — well mark this as complete in HubSpot once signed and evidence is uploaded.

Best regards,
Alex Martinez
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
Attachments: signed_bridge_letter.pdf
